name: design-tokens
goal: Refactor globals.css into dual-theme CSS custom properties (dark + light) and migrate lavender accent palette to pte-web blue brand palette
design_constraints: Cook confirms unit-test and quality-gate choices before each phase
All existing dark-mode visuals must remain pixel-identical after token migration — only the accent hue changes (lavender → blue)
Light theme tokens must map semantically to pte-web design-tokens.css values where applicable
Theme switching via html[data-theme='dark'] / html[data-theme='light'] attribute; default is dark
No Tailwind utilities — pte-practice uses vanilla CSS only

steps.description: Refactor :root in globals.css: rename existing dark palette vars under html[data-theme='dark'] (or :root default) and replace every lavender/purple reference with a blue palette derived from pte-web's brand tokens (--brand: #4169e8, --brand-soft: #5d87ff, etc.). Create matching --accent, --accent-strong, --accent-soft tokens replacing --lavender, --lavender-strong, --lavender-soft.
success_criteria: globals.css contains html[data-theme='dark'] block with all dark palette tokens
All --lavender* variables are replaced by --accent* variables using blue hues from pte-web
Existing color-scheme: dark is preserved for default

steps.description: Add html[data-theme='light'] block to globals.css with a complete light-mode palette: --page maps to pte-web --surface-page (#f2f6fa), --surface to white, --text to --ink-primary (#2a3547), --muted to --ink-secondary (#5a6a85), --accent to --brand (#4169e8), --line to --divider (#e5eaef), etc. Add color-scheme: light.
success_criteria: html[data-theme='light'] block exists with semantically mapped light palette tokens
color-scheme: light is set inside the light block
Every CSS variable used in component classes has a light-mode counterpart

steps.description: Search-and-replace all hardcoded lavender/purple color literals in globals.css component classes (e.g. rgb(184 174 255 / ...), #c6beff, #29213b, #171126, #201c28) with the corresponding --accent-based variable or updated blue-tinted equivalents. Ensure every class rule references only CSS variables, never raw hex/rgb that would break theme switching.
success_criteria: No hardcoded lavender/purple hex or rgb values remain in component class rules
All accent-colored borders, backgrounds, and box-shadows use var(--accent*) or theme-aware equivalents
Visual output in dark mode is the same as before but with blue accent instead of lavender

steps.description: Update body, .student-shell, .side-rail, .top-bar, .search-pill, and other layout classes to use only CSS variables for background and backdrop colors (replace any remaining hardcoded dark-mode rgb like rgb(9 8 13 / 92%), #07060a, #0e0c12, etc. with var-based expressions that respond to theme switching).
success_criteria: All layout container backgrounds reference CSS variables
Both dark and light themes render correct backgrounds for shell, rail, top-bar, search-pill, and auth form inputs
